links.outcome: System usability (SUS) and usability barriers found in scenario-based testing with end users
links.effect: Mean SUS score 57 (grade D), suboptimal usability. Testing with 5 physical therapists surfaced barriers: power button access, no battery indicator, burdensome manual calibration, insufficient report detail.
links.quote: The mean SUS score was 57 (grade D), indicating suboptimal usability and the need for iterative design refinements.

links.outcome: Clinician-reported need for EHR integration of the AI gait system
links.effect: Participants emphasized needing integration with hospital electronic medical record systems, plus wireless operation and improved portability. The prototype was not integrated.
links.quote: They also emphasized the need for wireless operation, improved portability, and integration with hospital electronic medical record systems.

screen.reason: Empirical formative usability evaluation of an AI-based gait analysis system involving physical therapists in simulated/scenario-based tasks.
